lines.en: I drift along, feet off the ground.
My hem stirs without any wind.
No rush. I close in slowly.

lines.zh: 身后留着一道淡淡的影。
lines.en: A faint shadow trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我抬高下巴，从不看地面。
lines.en: Chin up, I never look at the ground.
Too open here. Nowhere to hide.
I go around you, half a circle.
My fingers trace the air, faintly tingling.
I walk with my ki drawn inward.

lines.zh: 脚步声很轻，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My footsteps are barely audible.
I walk slowly. You will not escape.
I stand there without a twitch.
Eyes half open, light turning within.
I am listening to your breathing.
This body could change at any moment.
I press my ki down a little.
The wind scatters before it reaches me.
I have no expression, and need none.
Wait. The moment is not here yet.
Your shadow lies at my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看自己的掌心。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my palm.
The power is still rising.
I say nothing and simply watch.

lines.zh: 这么安静的空气，很陌生。
lines.en: Such quiet air feels strange.
I am waiting for a single thought.
You look up, straight into me.
I am watching to see if you move first.
That body of yours is soft.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下头，没别的意思。
lines.en: I tilt my head. Nothing by it.
Still standing. That takes nerve.
I have seen every part of you.
Your ki is like a small lamp.
I do not blink. Neither should you.
What lies between us is simple.

lines.zh: 你身上有股熟悉的味道。
lines.en: There is a familiar smell about you.
I am weighing how much you are worth.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我不觉得好笑。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? I see no joke.
Step into the light.

lines.zh: 你还有最后一次机会开口。
lines.en: You have one last chance to speak.
Then do not blame me for what follows.
This wound is neither here nor there.

lines.zh: 这一击打断了我的连段。
lines.en: That blow cut my combo short.
You have soiled my clothes.
I touch the wound with my fingers.
Interesting. Again.
I clench my teeth.
This pain is unfamiliar.
I straighten. I have not fallen.
You will regret that blow.
You would lure me with that?
I do not eat such things, nor care for them.
Put it down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 这味道很淡，可我还是闻到了。
lines.en: The smell is faint, and still I caught it.
I reach out, but not to take.
I crushed it. Apologies.
I know whether I am hungry.

lines.zh: 这点分量，连一口都不够。
lines.en: That is not even a mouthful.
Raise it a little higher.
I accept. Say no more.

lines.zh: 我身躯一挡，你就停住了。
lines.en: I set my body and you stop short.
Do not touch me. It burns.
One turn of my shoulder and you slide off.
I am taller. I see further.
Did that hurt your hand?
Ram again. I still will not yield.

lines.zh: 我把手按在你肩上，稳住。
lines.en: I set a hand on your shoulder to steady you.
Think it through before you come close.
This holds little interest for me.
A little further. Do not intrude.

lines.zh: 魔人的血，不一定传下去。
lines.en: Majin blood does not always carry on.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，它就懂了。
lines.en: One look and it understands.
We have no need of words.
This calm will not last.
It reaches out before I do.

lines.zh: 我们一起站着，什么也不做。
lines.en: We stand together and do nothing.
No one comes tonight.
After dawn, we are enemies again.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that thing on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用指头一勾，它就上来。
lines.en: One crook of my finger and it rises.
What is this? Worth keeping?
I squeeze it. Soft.
Too filthy. I will not take it.
Unclaimed, therefore mine.
I turn it over slowly.
You dropped this. Take it back.
Holding it does not mean I care.
I have chosen you.
Do not run. It will not help.

lines.zh: 你的气，已经被我记住了。
lines.en: I have your ki memorized.
When I raise my hand, it starts.
I decide how this goes.

lines.zh: 你动了，那就算你答应了。
lines.en: You moved. That counts as consent.
I neither shout nor wait.
The distance is right.

lines.zh: 你的气太亮，藏不住位置。
lines.en: Your ki is too bright to hide your position.
I will snuff it out.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你是我的目标。
lines.en: From now, you are my target.
I let all my ki loose.
The ground begins to shake.
Do not expect anyone to come.
I count to three, then strike.
Three, and then I move.
I walk toward you, one step at a time.
Wherever you retreat, I am there.

lines.zh: 我不着急，你有的是时间怕。
lines.en: No hurry. You have plenty of time to fear.
I am bored of your techniques.
I raise a hand; ki swirls in my palm.
Your steps grow more scattered.
I leave a gap on purpose.
You will see it, and take the bait.
My ki is rising.
Your ki is dropping.
I am on your left now.
This round, I will not give ground.

lines.zh: 最后问一句，你还要打吗？
lines.en: One last question: do you still want this?
Silence is also an answer.
This palm strike will send you flying.
The flurry falls without a gap.

lines.zh: 我打得很有耐心，一下一下。
lines.en: I strike patiently, one after another.
Blasts chase from my hand.
I drive you out of the air.
That punch landed well.
My knee comes up into your middle.
You give half a step; I follow.
My hair is lifting with the power.
Ki wave. Do not block.
You are down. Can you still move?
I finish and step back to wait.

lines.zh: 这一下是提醒，不是最后一击。
lines.en: That was a warning, not the last blow.

lines.zh: 站起来，我不想打躺着的。
lines.en: Get up. I do not like hitting a man down.
A touch slower and you are gone.
I will beat you until your ki is gone.
I step out of empty space.
The air cracks first.
The sky here sits low.
Who placed me here?
I land without a sound.
The ki all around is muddled.
This world's scent is unfamiliar.
Stand first. Look after.
I raise a hand and the air goes still.
This body is heavier than I expected.
I draw my ki in and hide it.

lines.zh: 这么大的地方，人却很少。
lines.en: So much space, so few people.
First I must find something.
The light on me stings a little.
From now, I stay here.
This step is the signal to begin.
Fire crosses my skin and leaves a mark.
I hit bottom and a bone clicks.
Water floods my throat and I choke.
The blast wave shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 小气弹擦过，我闪晚了半拍。
lines.en: A small ki blast grazes me; I dodged half a beat late.
This force presses down on my ki.

lines.zh: 饿到这个地步，身子发虚。
lines.en: Starved this far, my body feels hollow.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的头发竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my hair stands up.
The ground is gone and I keep falling.
